_description: Scaffold recipe for contained core-energy orb effects. Covers idle reactor cores, charging orbs, and overload states with a white-hot center, filament breakup, turbulence, and strong emissive shell.

base_architecture.design_philosophy: Core energy should read as a contained but unstable power source. The center is hottest and near-white, thin filament arcs create high-frequency energy structure, and the outer plasma shell carries the warm orange body color.

emitter_layers.name: Core_Orb
emitter_layers.purpose: Primary white-hot center mass anchoring the effect read
emitter_layers.spawn_rate: 1-3 persistent particles attached to the orb center
emitter_layers.opacity_over_life: mostly stable with a very slight pulse
emitter_layers.notes: This is the dominant read. Keep it compact so the orb does not become a flat glowing disk.

emitter_layers.name: Filament_Arcs
emitter_layers.purpose: Thin swirling plasma filaments and arc streaks inside the orb volume
emitter_layers.material_type: M_CoreEnergy_Filaments (Additive, high-contrast filament mask, panning distortion)
emitter_layers.size_over_life: hold thin width, taper slightly at the end
emitter_layers.velocity: tangential swirl 40-120 cm/s with inward-outward turbulence
emitter_layers.opacity_over_life: flash in fast, hold briefly, fade fast
emitter_layers.curl_noise: medium-high, multi-scale, biased to circular flow
emitter_layers.notes: Must read as thin energetic filaments, not soft cloudy noise. Branching and asymmetry are required.

emitter_layers.name: Plasma_Shell
emitter_layers.purpose: Warm emissive shell that gives the orb its spherical orange body
emitter_layers.material_type: M_CoreEnergy_Shell (Additive, soft shell gradient with animated breakup)
emitter_layers.opacity_over_life: soft stable shell, never fully opaque
emitter_layers.notes: Supports body volume. Do not let it overpower the core or hide the filaments.

emitter_layers.name: Secondary_Turbulence
emitter_layers.purpose: Soft internal energy motion behind the main filament layer
emitter_layers.notes: Adds depth behind the filaments. Keep contrast low so it does not muddy the read.

emitter_layers.name: Rim_Glow
emitter_layers.purpose: Controlled edge accent to reinforce spherical containment
emitter_layers.notes: This is a support read only. Avoid a thick outline or halo ring.

emitter_layers.name: Pulse_Sparks
emitter_layers.purpose: Short-lived accent sparks kicked off during stronger energy surges
emitter_layers.spawn_rate: 4-12/sec during surges or burst 6-16 on pulse peaks
emitter_layers.notes: Keep these sparse. They are punctuation, not the main body.

idle_orb.description: Contained energy orb with stable pulsing and readable internal motion

charging_core.description: Core entering a charge-up state before release or activation

modifications.notes: Should feel like energy is compressing inward before release.

overload_core.description: Unstable overload state with stronger arcs, harsher flicker, and violent turbulence

modifications.notes: Use stronger asymmetry and more aggressive secondary motion.

reactor_core.description: Larger contained core for machine or environmental reactor visuals

modifications.notes: Readable from distance. Favor silhouette and pulse over tiny detail.

recommended_material_stack.core_mask: Radial or sphere mask for the white-hot center
recommended_material_stack.filament_breakup: High-contrast noise threshold or flow-mapped breakup for thin internal lines
recommended_material_stack.secondary_depth: Lower-contrast noise layer at a different scale and speed
recommended_material_stack.color_gradient: White-hot center to warm orange shell

niagara_authoring_notes.hero_read: Material does most of the heavy lifting. Niagara layers should support motion, pulse, and accent readability.
niagara_authoring_notes.filament_motion: Prefer orbit or tangential flow with curl noise rather than generic upward fountain motion.
niagara_authoring_notes.surge_behavior: Pulse_Sparks and higher filament density should be driven by a user intensity parameter.

key_principles.center_is_hottest: The hottest point must stay centered and near-white. If the whole orb becomes equally bright, the read collapses.
key_principles.filaments_not_clouds: Primary breakup must read as thin filament structure. Soft cloudy noise is an anti-pattern for this archetype.
key_principles.body_supports_core: The orange shell exists to sell volume and heat, not to replace the white-hot center.
key_principles.controlled_rim: The rim glow should help the orb feel contained, but must never turn into a thick donut outline.
key_principles.layered_motion: Use at least two motion scales: fast filament motion and slower secondary turbulence.
key_principles.pulse_with_intent: Pulsing should communicate contained energy pressure, not random brightness wobble.

niagara_modules_needed: Vortex Velocity or Rotate Around Point
